Hi, I run a logistics company and we use your platform for payouts to carriers. Our account is frozen and funds are stuck, so I need to understand what is happening. Can you tell me what PSD2 or strong customer authentication rules apply here, and what we need to do to get the account unfrozen?

Also, we have 249845 on our side that seems related to this. I am not sure if it is needed for your checks or for the anti-money-laundering review. Please let me know if you need anything else from us.

We just want to make sure we are following the rules correctly. Thanks for your help.
